about.headline: Even the smallest spark can light up a musical dream
about.description:
I hold a Master's degree in Popular Music Performance from the University of West London (UK), as well as a Master's from Raffles Music College in Singapore. Specialising in pop, jazz and children's vocals, I have devoted years to vocal education, with teaching experience spanning students aged 3 to 60. I have served as a Disney bilingual trainer, a guest vocal instructor at a Shanghai arts kindergarten, and Head of Children's Vocal Training at the Lee Wei Song Music Academy in Singapore.

My teaching integrates the Orff Schulwerk methodology, emphasising natural vocal production and creative expression, and I have developed a proprietary system of music-and-movement games that cultivates rhythm and musicality so children learn through play. I am at home across English, Japanese and Western jazz repertoire, skilled in mixed-voice technique, and able to teach songs in English and Japanese.

I stay active in creating and performing: in 2023 I released my original single and music video Sunflower Under the Moon; in 2024 I was invited to write lyrics for Embrace the Sun, a promotional song for the Hangzhou Asian Games; and I arranged and recorded vocal harmonies for My Prime, a campaign song featuring Korean stars Lee Min-ho and Jun Ji-hyun. As a core youth member of the Shanghai Philharmonic Choir, I performed in the large-scale symphonic choral work Set Sail at the Shanghai Concert Hall and in the original musical City of Dreams, and toured Shanghai with the show Library Brainwave. In 2017 I studied on exchange in Japan.

Honours include: Champion of the Shanghai Ocean University campus ‘Top 10 Singers’ competition, runner-up in an English singing contest, a group honour at the Shanghai Singing Competition, and an Outstanding Contribution Award at the China–Germany Art Exchange Festival; the Best Song Award at the 2023 SGSW ‘I Write My Song’ competition; and the Best Melody Award at the 25th Xin Qing Rong Ji Chinese Songwriting Competition hosted by the National University of Singapore — among others. I have also led student groups in university arts showcases.
about.philosophy: My teaching philosophy: Let music return to nature, let singing come from the heart.

courses.pageSubtitle: The public website shows three stages only; Ruby tracks detailed internal progress after class

sprout.title: Rainforest Sprout · Tadpole Pilot
sprout.desc: For ages 3-5, starting as a small pilot with 2-3 children. Orff movement, rhythm games, animal sounds and short echo singing help children open up without pushing the voice.

adventure.title: Rainforest Adventure · Kids Vocal Foundations
adventure.desc: For ages 6-8, building natural voice, pitch, breath and Chinese/English diction. The goal is a stable first solo with expression and clear at-home practice tasks.

star.title: Rainforest Star Voice · Ages 7-12
star.desc: For advanced children's voices aged 7-12, working toward pop songs, musical theatre, Chinese repertoire, exams or competitions. The first VOD course starts with Children's Voice 7-12.

courses.publicNote: The public site presents only the three course stages; the seven-level rainforest progress scale stays internal for teacher assessment.
courses.duoNote: 1-on-2 is not actively promoted; it is arranged only when the children, level, timing and partner fit.
courses.vodNote: The first recorded course is Children's Voice 7-12; a 15-minute sample will run through editing, upload and viewing first.
